help.title: Help
help.lead: Short answers to the most common questions.

code.a: First check your spam or promotions folder. Make sure the address is right – on the code step you can change it with “Use a different email”. After 30 seconds you can request a new code; only the newest one works. Our emails come from {sender}.

link.a: Ask in your group chat for the link. If you’ve already joined, just sign in – your trip is under “My trips”.

inApp.q: I opened the page in WhatsApp or Instagram.
inApp.a: That works. Just enter the code in the same window. Later you can also sign in on your browser with your email.

dates.q: How do I change my dates?
dates.a: Open the trip and go to “My dates”. Changes apply right away. Once the dates are locked in, your dates can’t be changed any more.

vote.a: Under “Vote” you choose Yes, Maybe or No for each date range. You can change your vote until voting ends. You’ll see how the others voted once you’ve voted yourself.

visibility.q: Who can see what I enter?
visibility.a: Only the members of the trip. We never ask for reasons – there’s just an optional comment.

delete.q: How do I delete my data?
delete.a: If you leave a trip (trip menu ⋯ → “Leave trip”), we delete your name, dates, votes and comment in that trip. As the organizer, hand over the role or delete the trip first. Under Account → Data & privacy you can also download all your data.

motion.a: Under Account → Appearance you can turn on “Reduce motion”: fewer animations, no confetti, no vibration. If “Reduce motion” is on in your device settings, it applies automatically.

noEmail.a: Write to us at {contact}. Alternatively, create a new account and join the trip again with the invite link.

group.a: How many people can make each day. The stronger the colour, the more can come; ✓ means everyone who has submitted can make it. Tap a day to see who can and who can't. Only submitted dates count – nobody sees drafts.

suggestions.q: Where do the suggestions come from?
suggestions.a: We look for periods at least as long as the organizer set. First come those where everyone can make it, then those where almost everyone can. With the filters (just for you) you can change the length or hide people – the group still sees the standard view.

fix.q: Who fixes the dates – and can that be changed?
fix.a: The organizer fixes the dates, usually after the vote. Then “My dates” are locked and everyone can add the dates to their calendar. The organizer can undo it; the votes are kept. The organizer can also cancel a running vote – your dates stay, a new vote follows.

account.q: How do I delete my account?
account.a: Go to Account → Data & privacy → “Delete account”. You confirm with a code (or password), then we immediately delete your name, email, dates and votes in all trips. If you organize trips with others, you first pick a new organizer for each trip or delete the trip for everyone.

retention.q: How long do you keep my data?
retention.a: Not forever: we delete a trip 90 days after it ends, or 12 months after the last change if no dates were fixed – the organizer hears from us 14 days before. Accounts not used for 24 months are deleted after a reminder. We use no trackers and no advertising cookies.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.updated: Last updated: [PLACEHOLDER: date of this version]
privacy.summary:
We only store what the app needs: your account (name, email, language, region), your trips with your dates, votes and comment, and technical sign-in data. Only the members of a trip see what you enter in it.

No trackers, no ads, no advertising cookies. You can download your data, leave a trip or delete your account at any time. We delete old trips and long-unused accounts automatically.

controller.title: Controller
controller.body:
[PLACEHOLDER: name of the operator (private person)]

[PLACEHOLDER: address for service]

Email: [PLACEHOLDER: contact email]

account.title: Your account
account.body: For your account we store your display name, email address, language, region (date format, week start, holidays), the “Reduce motion” setting and – if you set one – a password hash. Purpose: providing the app; legal basis: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (contract). Taking part is not possible without an email address.

trips.title: Trips
trips.body: For each trip we store membership, role, your name in the trip, your dates (“if need be”, “can't”), your optional comment and your votes. The other members of the same trip see these entries with your name. Placeholder names are added by the organizer – please use first names or nicknames only. Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR. Suggestions are not binding; there is no automated decision (Art. 22 GDPR).

signIn.title: Sign-in and security
signIn.body: You sign in with a code or link by email, optionally with a password (stored only as an Argon2id hash). We store sessions with IP address and browser identifier to protect your account, and we count sign-in attempts to limit abuse – addresses only as a non-reversible key. Server logs with IP addresses are deleted after 7 days. Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in a secure service).

mails.title: Emails
mails.body: We only send emails your account needs: codes, password reset, email change, notices before automatic deletion and the confirmation of an account deletion. No marketing, no newsletter, no tracking pixels.

recipients.title: Recipients and hosting
recipients.body: Hosting: [PLACEHOLDER: hosting provider, servers in Germany]. Email delivery: [PLACEHOLDER: email provider]. Both process data only on our behalf (Art. 28 GDPR). No data is transferred to third countries.

device.title: Cookies and storage on your device
device.body: We only use technically necessary storage: the sign-in cookie, the chosen language, the “Reduce motion” choice, the state of the legend in the group calendar, an invite during sign-in and a trip draft in your browser. Legal basis: Section 25(2) no. 2 TDDDG. That's why there is no cookie banner.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: Account: until you delete it, at the latest after 24 months without use (notice 30 days before). Trips: until the organizer deletes them, at the latest 90 days after the fixed end of the trip or 12 months after the last change (notice to the organizer 14 days before). If you leave a trip, we delete your entries in it immediately. Codes are valid for 15 minutes, abuse counters for at most 24 hours. Backups are overwritten after 30 days at the latest.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, data portability and objection (Art. 15–21 GDPR). Much of this works right in the app: download your data and delete your account under Account → Data & privacy, leave a trip in the trip menu. Otherwise write to [PLACEHOLDER: contact email]. You can complain to a supervisory authority: [PLACEHOLDER: competent supervisory authority].

automated.title: Statistics
automated.body: We only count usage in aggregate on the server, without cookies and without reference to individual people.
